acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given a debt account with monthly compounding, when I calculate monthly interest, then the formula used is: monthlyInterest = balance x (annualRate / 12) with cent-level accuracy (2 decimal places in ZAR)

Given a flexi facility with daily compounding, when I calculate daily interest, then the formula is: dailyInterest = balance x (annualRate / 365) and monthly approximation is: monthlyInterest = dailyInterest x daysInMonth
Given an account linked to SA prime rate, when I calculate interest with prime linkage, then the effective rate = prime rate + margin (e.g., prime + 2% margin = 13.75% total if prime is 11.75%)
All calculations use big.js for arbitrary precision decimal arithmetic, preventing floating-point errors
Results are accurate to 2 decimal places (cent-level in ZAR) with no accumulated rounding errors

Unit tests verify calculations against manual spreadsheet examples: - R100,000 at 11.5% annual = R958.33/month - R50,000 flexi at 12% annual = R16.44/day - Prime (11.75%) + 2% margin = 13.75% effective rate
Functions are pure, deterministic, and framework-agnostic (can be used outside React context)

node.purpose: Arbitrary precision decimal arithmetic for financial calculations (ADR-003)

constraints.constraint: All monetary calculations MUST use big.js. Never use native JavaScript number arithmetic for financial values. (ADR-003)
Round results to 2 decimal places for cent-level accuracy in ZAR. Use Big.roundHalfUp mode.
Store all monetary values and rates as strings to preserve big.js precision. Convert to Big only for calculations.
Store interest rates as decimals (0.115 = 11.5%), not percentages. Document this convention clearly.
All calculation functions must be pure, deterministic, and have no side effects. Must work outside React context.
Verify calculations against known spreadsheet values. Test floating-point edge cases (0.1 + 0.2).
Place calculation code in src/lib/calculations/. Create barrel export in index.ts. Tests in tests/lib/calculations/.

tests.standards: Tests use Vitest with @testing-library. Test files mirror source structure in tests/ directory. Use describe/it blocks with descriptive names referencing acceptance criteria (e.g., "AC-4.1.1"). Verify calculations against known spreadsheet values. Test edge cases: zero balance, zero rate, empty strings. Test big.js precision with floating-point edge cases (0.1 + 0.2 should equal 0.3). Current test count: ~835 tests passing. Maintain test hygiene - no regressions.
